balls.text: finally tries the yorker, ends u bowling a low full toss, hit down to long-on for one. They try the second but Kuldeep ends up sacrificing himself
well this is a filthy little hit-me ball. Slower ball but down the leg side, and Porel flicks it over square leg for a six. What an Impact Sub he is proving out to be
lovely ramp shot. Harshal rolls his fingers on the short ball, gets it chest high, not much room, but Porel helps it along over short third
another slower short ball, 125ks, into the body, but he has smacked this pull bang in the middle of deep midwicket and long leg
slower ball, 121ks, Porel has picked it and picked the bones out of him. Right in the slot, and he slogs it big over midwicket
slower short ball, 127ks, very good line, at his right shoulder, but the top edge carries over short fine for four
quicker bouncer, 131ks, beats Kuldeep's attempt to make room and upper-cut him. Another good over for PBKS
slower bouncer, into the body, pulled down to long leg for one
he has given it up as he runs the non-existent single after pushing this shortish ball to point. The throw misses, and they get the single
now Arsh goes full, 134ks, seam slanting towards slip, and there is a bit of movement in the air to take the edge on the attempted big hit from Sumit
quicker ball, stays short of a length, 134ks, good carry, and beats him for the pace really
proper slower bouncer this time but too high according to the umpire. Called a wide, and PBKS review it. Replays confirm it is too high. They lose the review
slower short ball, Sumit delays his cut but is still beaten by it
part intended, part accidental. Throws his hands at a wide shortish ball, gets a thick edge that goes fine of deep third for four
slower short ball again, wide outside off, pulled into the leg side for one
slower bouncer, pulled down to deep midwicket for a single
wide on the crease, on-pace length ball, hits the pad with the angle, goes for a leg-bye
on a length, outside off, pushed wide of mid-off for one

Close call on the run-out. The third umpire comes in. Short of a length, slower ball, angling in, Axar bunts it into the leg side, wants a second to keep strike but the substitute fielder Tanay's throw from deep square is on the money. Axar is caught short. No dive either
slower short ball, Axar runs it down behind square for a single
dug in short, outside off, Sumit gets off the mark with a pull that he keeps down
another dot. This is short, this is wide, but he has found backward point
slower short ball, into the body, helps it along to long leg with a pull
Axar fighting for a total to bowl to. Upper-cuts Rabada and uses all his pace. Not much width but he unfurls the cut and clears deep third. Never tries tokeep it down
on a length, top of off, no room, Axar opens the face but can't beat point
tries the flighted delivery after pushing him back. Sumit pushes it towards cover, and hesitant running among the batters costs them a possible single
short of a length, no room, punched back to him

looks for the inside-out chip over extra cover, but again the lack of turn for Chahar perhaps means he ends up hitting it much straighter than desired. Shashank makes a good run to his left from long-off and completes a diving catch. And credit where it's due: this ball does drift in to hit him on the inner half of the bat
length-ball legbreak, Stubbs stays back and makes room to punch this in front of deep cover for two
on a length, just outside off, cut away to deep cover
short of a length, no room, worked into leg side, Stubbs slips as he looks to turn for the second
fuller, just short of driving length, punched down to mid-off for another dot
short again, and this time there is width to go with it. Axar punches it to the left of backward point for four
short of a length, not much room, but Axar has managed to cut it over backward point for two
nice little drive, but straight to mid-off. He is trying to go wide of mid-off but fails to do so
on a length, angling in, pushed down to long-on for one
on a length, angling in, defended by Stubbs
looks to guide it fine down the leg side, is beaten and hit on the pad
on a length, just outside off, punched to deep cover
cut to deep cover for a single
first boundary off Brar comes off an edge. No slip at 111 for 5. There can be argument for it. Axar plays for turn, but this one keeps angling across and takes the outside edge

appeal for catch down the leg side, the umpire calls it a wide, and PBKS review it. This is fired into the pads, Bhui gets inside it, looks for a tickle fine to fine leg, and UltraEdge confirms he has gloved it. A second catch decision successfully reviewed by PBKS
on a length, middle and off, defended back to him. Not quite to its pitch
slower short ball again, 124ks, also low bounce. Takes the toe end of the bat on the pull
wide on the crease, full, punched nicely but straight to mid-off

Patel makes up for the drop catch. And again with the slower short ball. Bowled at 123ks, Pant looks to ramp it behind square, but the lack of pace means he ends up lobbing a catch to backward point. Pant is furious with himself
down the wicket, goes inside-out, shanks it, but clears extra cover easily. Comes back for two
text-book extra-cover drive. Patel pitches it up, mid-off is up, and Pant drives with a slightly open face to pierce the gap between mid-off and cover
short of a length, tucked away off the hip, but a nice whip in the end to place it behind square to let him come back for the second
wrong'un, too full and outside leg. Pant mis-hits an attempted big slog sweep. Just the single to deep square
punched wide of Chahar for a single, beating his dive to his left
looks to cut but can't beat cover
short of a length, short-arm pull
Harshal Patel has dropped Pant. Another filthy delivery by the way. A long hop, pulled straight to deep midwicket but Patel has lost it in the sun
filthy full toss hit straight to deep midwicket for a single. Needed some anger behind that shot
on a length, 138ks, outside off, he steers it down to deep third for one
short of a length, outside off, Bhui opens the face but plays it straight to point
Rabada comes back. This length ball, bowled at 141ks, might have just stopped a touch on him and Hope almost plays a check-drive straight and low to short cover
Rabada has tried to bowl into the surface but it hasn't worked for him. Another pull for a six off him. Hope stays on the crease, clears his front leg and goes over deep midwicket
short of a length, good carry, no room. Pant gets just the single to deep cover
cramps him up with a length ball angling in. A single down to long-on
short of a length, pushed through, punched down to long-on for one
gets some bat on the reverse-sweep but just for a single to short third
down the wicket early, Chahar keeps it slow, beats him in the air, beats him comprehensively, and Pant's pad saves him
short of a length, he goes back to pull it to deep midwicket
slog-sweep bang in the middle of deep square and deep midwicket. Clears the front leg, takes this from outside leg and doesn't bother with keeping the sweep down
full legbreak, driven to cover
stays back to a fullish flat delivery. Punched down to long-on for one. Brar has gone through two overs without conceding a boundary
down the wicket to work a full ball into the leg side for one
makes room to crunch this straight of deep cover. Two available but Pant turns down the second
Pant's second innings in cricket is off the mark. Turns a full ball into the leg side for a single
length ball, pushed across him, Pant down on a knee as he cuts. Can't find the gap
wide length ball, cut away to deep point

lovely slower bouncer. Harshal is celebrating a catch at the wicket, but the umpire hasn't given it. PBKS review it. Ultra Edge confirms there is a bit of a tope edge and also a chunk of the glove on the ball. Warner has to go
low full toss as he attempts a yorker. Hope gets a single wide of mid-off
digs this in short, cut away to deep cover for a single
wide on the crease, full, on off, 138ks, driven inside-out but straight to extra cover
gets the yorker right now, Warner c an only dig it out for a dot
lovely shot. Full outside off, nearly a yorker, but Warner has cleared his front leg and places the drive perfectly through extra cover

Curran is having a shocker of an afternoon. After the early ordinary over to start the match, he lets one go at backward point to turn a dot into four. Cut away by Hope but it quickly turns into despair for Chahar
Hope's first IPL six. High time he did get a move on. Skips down the track, takes this on the half-volley and lofts him over long-on
goes back to a full ball, drops it into the leg, Warner wants the second but Hope sends him back
some turn on this length ball, cut away to deep cover
on a length, middle and leg, punched down to long-on for one
short of a length, not much room, cut to deep cover
he has done well superbly with what is traditionally a difficult over, the last of the powerplay. Just the single as Hope drives a full ball to long-off
short of a length, outside off, punched down to long-on for one
flat, outside off, cut away, but straight to cover-point
another slog, falls just short of deep midwicket
looks for the big shot, but he has stayed back to a fullish bball and mis-hits this for another dot
on a length, no turn, cramps Hope up. Pushed back to him
some seam movement here. Warner is looking to open the face to run this behind square, but it beats him on the inside edge

Rabada is being taken apart here. Warner has used all his pace. Smashed the slower ball last ball so he is expecting pace on the ball, shuffles across, gets on a knee, takes this from wide outside off and still puts it over long leg with a flick-ramp
on a length, angling across, slower ball actually, 125ks, but gives him then width to drive this wide of mid-off for four more
big mow at a length ball. This is in the slot, but Warner gets an inside edge onto the pad
short of a length again, a bit of width, top-edges the cut for a single to deep backward point
short of a length, outside off, looks to open the face and run, but hasn't found the gap
Hope's first run in the IPL as he drops and runs. Arsh has bowled a slower ball, which means Hope aborts any designs he might have on a big shot
short of a length, no room, defensively played
nearly a yoeker, Hope watchful in pushing to mid-on
full, outside off, driven to cover
wide on the crease, wide half-volley, Marsh square-drives, but finds short cover-point to perfection. Arshdeep has got lucky with this one
lovely shot. Nice stride into the length ball, gets under it, and languidly off-drives it over mid-off. Superb shot
short of a length, good carry, no room. Warner defends
short of a length, into the pads, beats his bat but concedes a leg-bye
wide length ball, doesn't get all of the drive, mis-hits to cover
short again, down the leg side again, enough of a touch on it. Off the thigh pad, I think. Goes between the keeper and short fine
short of a length, just outside off, pushed to cover
Rabada is trying to bowl into the surface, but this short ball has sat up nicely for Marsh to pull for a six. He just uses his pace and helps it along behind square
bowls into the surface but way down the leg side. All three bowlers have bowled a wide at least
hint of swing for the first time for Arshdeep today. Beats Warner just outside off as he looks to loft him over mid-off
full and wide, too wide. Warner can't make a connection with it. Called wide
fuller now. No swing. On the line of off. Pushed to cover
short, wide, and cut away. Finds the gap expertly. between cover-point and cover
well he has had enough sighters. Arshdeep goes upstairs, but not high enough nor quick enough. Warner pulls him in front of square for a six
on a length, around top of off, Warner happy to defend and get a hang of the pitch
short of a length, wide, cut away to short cover-point
on a length, just outside off, defended towards mid-off
walks at Curran, reaches the wide ball on the half-volley, but the drive can't beat the fielder at cover
down the leg side, so far down that Marsh can't get a touch on it
walks at him, drives nicely, straight of mid-off, but not past him
down the leg side again, and Marsh says thank you very much. This time he flicks more than glances it. To the left of short fine now
this ball swings, and swings too far down leg. Marsh expertly glances it fine of short fine for four
no swing, gentle pace, dropped into the leg side for him

Clean as a whistle, slugged over cow corner and Punjab Kings start their journey in Mullanpur with a win. Was a wide ball on a length. 119ks, Livingstone lunged and had ample time as the ball sat up to be clobbered across the line
Livingstone's missed out on the wide shortish ball, he's slapped the face off of it but finds cover
Another wide. Short one bounces well above head height
Wide and shortish, let go. Easy wide picked up

David Warner has dropped it at long-on! That's probably the unlikeliest event today as he has been a livewire in the field. He ran in and tried to cup the ball but it popped out. Was a shortish ball outside off, bounce too high and Harpreet clothed the pull
Beats bat. Shortish on fifth, Harpreet looked to have tried to upper cut it fine. Done for pace again

Shashank has been bounced out first ball, Khaleel on a hat-trick. Pacy and at the armpit, the batter was done for pace and cramped for room as he tried to pull. Ball popped off the glove for Pant to take a dolly. Khaleel and Pant share a glance of understanding, this seems to be a plan coming off

Heaves across the line, Curran misses but not Khaleel. Offcutter on a length, lands outside off and comes back in. Curran was too early on the shot and it hit top of off. Preity Zinta applauds and is all smiles as Curran walks back
Wide and full, good from Khaleel to keep it out the arc, Livingstone tries smearing it but can only inside edge it to long-on
Full at the stumps, helps it to deep fine leg with a flick

Marsh's short ball is hooked over fine leg again, by the right-hander this time and the asking rate is now 5. The short boundaries were behind, so Marsh's ploy of digging it into the pitch at a manageable pace, was shaky. Livingstone didn't have to much as he was readily inside the line, lifted it with precision. Both players exchange a smile
Wide and shortish, bottom-edged cut takes it to mid-off
Full at the stumps, worked to the bowler's left. Stopped in follow-through
Curran is sliding along the crease to put Marsh off his line. Got one on a back of length this time, fourth stump but he'd opened up enough to get room for the cut through backward point
Pick-up hook over the short boundary at deep fine leg! Shortish ball, around head-height but it's not pacy. Curran got his head to the offside to get well inside the line and help it along
Into the pitch, outside off. Liam tries flat-batting but top edges it over the bowler
Wide and full, flapped to long-off
Livngstone is chuffed after helping it fine. Length on the pads, he tried to pick it up with a heave, might've gotten it off the bottom but it raced away
And gets a lucky four straight of short third. Pant flew to the right but was too wide for him too. Offcutter around yorker length outside off, Livingstone tried to flap it over cover
Whippage. Along the ground to the left of deep midwicket. Very full at 125ks, at the stumps
Curran makes room and almost gets knocked over. Tried to steer the length on middle with a fully open face and bottom edged it into the pitch
Wide and shortish, 122ks, cut hard to deep point
Full outside off, steered to deep point
Lucky not to have dragged it back onto the stumps. Fullish outside off at 98ks, Liam tried to leather it through cover
Brings up fifty by dinking a length ball on off, to long-on. 98ks. Curran raises his bat, crowd being egged on by the dj
Gets away with a short and wide on as Sumit half-stops the bullet at cover. Curran latched onto it with another powerful cut
Length on leg, worked to midwicket
Length around off, punched to long-on

Pummelled over square leg, this might be the game-changing over! Legcutter into the pitch, just outside off, Livingstone stepped across and bulleted it. It's a pull with a baseball-like swing to pick up the flattest of sixes
Bunts the back of lengther on fifth, to long-off. 12 off the first five legal balls. Curran has a word with his partner
Deftly patted towards deep midwicket for a quick two. Was a length ball on the pads that was flicked with minimal power. Smart play
Curran waiting deep in the crease, Marsh goes full, slow and wide. Too wide in the end. 114ks again, let go
Another bouncer, but Curran's ready this time. Slower one, in at the batter, pulled from around face-height with a swivel. Came at an easy pace and it was hit well behind square
Really short ball, angles away to go over fifth. Curran tries to ramp it fine, misses. Height good enough for the ball to be fair
Offers width and Curran slaps it through cover. Slow on a length, angling away, Curran didn't have to transfer weight or move his feet, just waited and belted it
Punches the length ball at the stumps, to long-on, to see Kuldeep off
Length at the stumps, too close for the cut. Curran ends up underedging it to his left
Full just outside off, 81ks, looked to be turning away and Curran was too quick on the shot. Spooned a bit but goes safely to cover
Length on leg, clipped to deep midwicket

Stubbs spills it, running to the left from long-on! Was a 79ks length ball spinning away from off, Curran swiped across but the spin took it away from the middle. Stubbs did all the work, tried to take a sliding catch but couldn't hold on.
Length outside off, slaps it but off the underedge, between cover and point. Fielders were closeish and charged, batters scampered too and made it
Full at the stumps, clipped to square leg.
Punched forward again
Tucks him up with a length ball in at the stumps, worked back to the bowler. Timing's off through
Wide on a length, slapped to deep point

Dances down and whips it on the move. Warner is amazing in the outfield again, races to the right from long-on and stops the travelling ball with his right hand. Was a shortish ball angling outside off,
Darter into a length on leg, 98ks, worked to deep midwicket
Full on middle, worked to long-on
Fuller side of length on leg, clipped to backward square leg
Full on leg, clipped to deep square leg

Another appeal for stumping. Pant is all smiles. Is Jitesh walking? Sent upstairs. Was a length ball down leg, Jitesh went for the expansive reverse sweep. He missed it and was mid-jump and out of the crease. Meanwhile, Pant lunged low, stretched his upper body as far forward as he could and pushed the ball into the stumps. That oughta reaffirm thoughts around his keeping
Flicks it from middle and off to midwicket
Wide on a length, Jitesh reaches out and tries to sweep. Plinks it towards short third. Throw is to the left of Kuldeep and the batter was running in.
Full ball is pushed to long-on
Short and wide, slapped through the gap at cover. "Like serving candy to a baby" says Daren Ganga. 107ks, sat up just above waist height.
Length outside off, defended towards cover point for a quick single
Shortish 120ks ball has been pulled across to the cow-corner boundary. Easy pace, smacked along the ground
WIde on a length, steered to deep point

Sumit might have a stumping first ball! Sent upstairs. Length ball down leg, Jitesh tried to clip it with one foot just inside the crease and the other just outside. He missed the ball and couldn't hold onto his balance. He stretched his front foot back. Third umpire's checking if there's bat involved. Ultra-Edge coming up, no bat involved. Replays confirm he's just in Good keeping from Pant, who was blinded, pushed the ball into the stumps rather quickly but Jitesh's desperate swivel saved him.
Full around off, worked to long-on
Doesn't rise and beats the outside edge. 89ks on a length just outside off, Jitesh caught in the crease while trying to defend it straight
Full outside off, driven to cover. Pant egging on his team-mates
Kuldeep happy to err on the fuller side for the new ball. Wide and full, 85ks, driven to the sweeper on the offside
Kuldeep gives it air and reaps rewards. Googly at 83ks is full and outside off, Prabhsimran tried to thrash it over the fielder but found Warner at long-on. Looked to have dipped a bit
Dances down and nudges it around the corner
Full around fourth, defended to cover
Full at the stumps, pushed to long-on
Tucks the length ball on the pads, to square leg
Makes room and opens up wide long-off. He converted Axar's consistency into-the-pitch length to his advantage
Darted on a back of length, fifth stump, short-arm pulled to long-on
Dances down and chips it over the bowler, single to long-on
Good from Kuldeep, pushing it to the fuller side of length. Curran still goes back, defends it towards midwicket
Curran capitalises on Kuldeep's length being a touch on the shorter side. Stayed deep in the crease, swivel-pulled it through the gap at square leg
Wide on a length, spins back in a bit, 87ks, half-timed slap takes it to long-off
Comes down and whacks it on the bounce to long-on

Smart reactions from Kuldeep, who saw the batter dance down but his reflexes were good too. Kuldeep went shortish and really wide, Prabhsimran had to play it (else he'd be stumped). He reached out with his upper body and slapped it with one hand, to long-off
Length on middle, punched to long-on
Length around fifth, slapped to long-off
Length n leg, goes back in the crease and tucks it towards deep midwicket
Length around off, clipped through forward square leg. They're trying to milk two but the deep-fielders have been swooping in smartly
Back-foot punch takes the length ball to long-on

Huge lbw appeal, was Prabhsimran too far down the pitch? Not given. Axar and Pant have a chat, DRS used with two seconds to go. It was a shortish ball and the batter had danced well down, he tried to drive through mid-off, got beaten on the inside edge. Ball hit the outer-edge of the front pad, a few inches below the knee-roll. Off stump is visible from straight-on. Third umpire confirms that it was only pad. The batter was over three metres down, the projection's taking the ball down leg too.
Length on leg, nudged to deep midwicket. Fielder comes in early enough to deny two
Caresses it off the back foot to the sweeper on the offside
Prabhsimran wanted the run, came halfway down and Curran, a couple of feet outside his crease, sends him back. Axar takes a bit of time to fire the throw towards the bowler's end. Was a bit off too.
Full outside off, pushed to cover

Uh oh, Ishant twists his right ankle trying to to stop the ball at midwicket, slipped badly says Nagraj from the ground. Physio's (Patrick Farhart and Co) out, he looked in pain. He's being helped up by a couple of people and is taking very ginger trods forward. Hope he's okay. Was a slower length ball that was tucked gently along the ground
Length at the stumps, tucked towards deep square leg. They think of two but get one
Cross-seamer has been biffed wide of mid-off. Length ball offered a bit of room, not much bounce and Curran took the momentum into the shot, slapped it along the ground for four
Smashed through cover, Khaleel goes full and Prabhsimran is all over it. Danced down and spanked it with a full follow-through. Smeared it

Pulled over midwicket, heck of a shot given it was left-arm around the wicket, 139ks, angling in at him. Luckily the shortish ball was around top-of-thigh height. He still had to have a proper hack, which he did while holding shape
Length on fifth, 138ks, bunted off the top of the bounce while standing upright. Pierces it into the outfield at cover
Length on fifth, tries defending away from the body. Aims for mid-off, gets it to backward square off the inside edge
Yorker on off, jammed to the bowler's right
Length ball is defended
Falls just short of Ishant, as he tries to take a low catch in follow-through On the fuller side and Prabhsimran, trying to nudge it across, looked to have gotten a leading edge on it

Has Ishant tipped the ball in follow-through to run Bairstow out? Yeah, poor YJB. This was more unlucky though and he resigns with a smile while walking back. Was a slow ball into the pitch to which Prabhsimran charged and cuffed with a cross-ish bat. It poured along the pitch, Ishant went low to the right and got just a fingertip to it. Smart replays with multiple angles confirms and it and YJB, diving back, couldn't make it in time.
Length on fifth, defended to cover
Prabhsimran fights back, charges down and slaps it wide of mid-off.

Test seed from Ishant, unluckily it's four to third. Scramble-seam fro over the wicket, lands it on the perfect length and squares up Prabhsimran. He was caught between playing on the front and back foot and ended up fending meekly with a straightish bat. Outside edge took it to the left of the diving short third

Ishant rattles middle stump! He wins the battle of the Delhiites. Dhawan danced down, looked premeditated, and tried to heave across the line. Looked to have bounced lower than Dhawan expected. The 137ks ball zipped past him. Ishant's off in celebration.
Overpitched again, just outside off, crunched but straight to Warner, the cover-point sweeper, again
Length on middle. Top-of-stump height. Defended to cover. 131ks
Warner is a hare, running to the right from deep point, and he saves two
A bit of extra bounce. Hard length at middle and leg, Bairstow tried punching it towards mid-off, got it off the splice. A bit uppish but Bairstow had pulled out enough power for it to be safe
Pitched up around off, punched through the line. Mid-off stops it
Squirted wide of backward point, in the air at a hovering, catchable height but well to the fielders' left. It was a half-volley outside off and Dhawan got on one knee, threw his hands at it
Check drive, spooned a bit but lands safely and goes to mid-off's right. Fullish ball outside off, might've come off the pitch slower than Dhawan expected.

Big appeal from Ishant for lbw, was the angle too sharp? Umpire probs thinks so, no review. He's changed his angle, Dhawan went across outside off, too far in the end. The 135ks length ball angled in at leg and beat the flick. Hawk-Eye shows it'd have gone on to clip leg stump, so on-field call would have stayed
Similar ball, Dhawan is forward but not with as firm a charge, pats it to the offside again
Dances down and gets opened up. Ishant goes length around off, seam pointing towards third, Dhawan searches and hangs his bat out. Fends square on the offside
Still wide but the initial angle made it seem like it was gonna come in. Length ball. Dhawan ended up defending very close to the body, intention was to leave the sixth-stump line ball go
Third wide of the over is exaggerated by the swing. But the starting line itself is a bit too wide. Dhawan smartly letting it go
Grass-sizzling slap through point. Went just to the left of Axar, who didn't pick it up. Pant not happy with the effort. Was a wide length ball to which Dhawan charged and belted with a cross bat
Pretty much the same. Dhawan takes a step down and knows he doesn't have to play at that
Gets it too wide outside off. Fuller side of length, shaped away a bit but started too wide

Driven through cover. Bairstow is on the front dog, walks into the top-of-bounce drive. He got width and Khaleel's errors have cost Capitals a 17-run opening over. It's the most for Punjab Kings, if I heard Murali Karthik right
Skilful from YJB. Guided wide of gully. Length ball angling away through fourth, he waited and opened the face last second, got it fine enough too. All Khaleel can do is smile
Gets a bit too straight, more because of the angle, Dhawan helps it along. Three-quarter length, lucky for Khaleel it went to fine leg
Crashed wide of third. Khaleel's going wide and being punished. 140ks on a length but that just helped Dhawan lunge a bit and use the pace, he drove it late and along the ground
Length outside off, patted with an open face to point.

Short and wide, slapped in front of point. 138ks and Dhawan eased into the cut, stayed on top of the bounce and his front leg was hovering up as he got it into the ground. Not perfectly timed but well enough
